description: This file defines the LoadedProperty class which implements the PropertyReflection interface. It represents a property in the PHPStan static analysis context, providing information about declaring class, type, accessibility, and other metadata related to a property.

classes.name: LoadedProperty
classes.description: Implements the PropertyReflection interface to represent a class property with metadata such as type, visibility, and mutability.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance of LoadedProperty with the declaring class, property type, and writability.

methods.name: getDeclaringClass
methods.description: Returns the reflection object of the class that declares this property.

methods.name: isStatic
methods.description: Returns false indicating the property is not static.

methods.name: isPrivate
methods.description: Returns false indicating the property is not private.

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Returns true indicating the property is public.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Returns true indicating the property is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Returns whether the property is writable.

methods.name: getDocComment
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no doc comment is associated.

methods.name: getReadableType
methods.description: Returns the type of the property as a Type object.

methods.name: getWritableType
methods.description: Returns a NeverType indicating that the property cannot be written to.

methods.name: canChangeTypeAfterAssignment
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the property type cannot change after assignment.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Returns a TrinaryLogic value indicating the property is not deprecated.

methods.name: getDeprecatedDescription
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no deprecation description.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Returns a TrinaryLogic value indicating the property is not internal.
